utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Saturday at 10 a.m. at the community center should work for the repair drive. What else still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That works for me, but what should I bring? I want to make sure we’ve got the right tools and enough time to sort the logistics.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Could you bring any basic tools you have, plus extension cords and a few power strips? I’ll check on table space and a sign-in sheet so we can keep the logistics moving.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So you’re sure they still need screwdrivers, a cordless drill, and nails? That’s the list, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, that’s the list I heard — screwdrivers, a cordless drill, and nails. I’ll pass along the next update as soon as I get it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Alright, just checking — can you confirm the community center is still our first stop?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yep, that’s right — I’m still pulling the rest together, but the community center is first. I’ll pass along the pickup time as soon as I’ve got it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — I’ll keep an ear out for the pickup time and the next stops. Thanks for the update.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Nell — I’ll let you know as soon as I’ve got the pickup time and the rest of the stops.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: The community center is the first stop I’ve got noted, and I’m aiming for a window that wraps before pickup time. I’ll keep tracking the rest as we go.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That works for me — if we wrap before pickup, I can help line up parents around school dismissal. What time are you thinking for the community center?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m thinking late morning, maybe 10 to 11:30 at the community center. That should leave us plenty of room before pickup, and I’ll keep an eye on the rest of the route.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll update the volunteer list first. Send me the supplies you have so far when you can.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, thank you, Leo. I’ll send the supplies list over now, and we can fill in anything still missing after that.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I’ll keep the volunteer list updated and watch for your supplies list.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m out running errands now, so I’ll keep an ear out for extra tools, tape, and anyone willing to help. See you at 10 if I can make it!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Ira — thanks for keeping an eye out. We’re still set for 10 at my place, and if you hear of anyone else who can lend a hand, send them my way!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: You got it — I’ll spread the word and bring anything useful I find. See you at 10 if I can make it!

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep — tell them the usual spot by the community center, and we’ll start in the afternoon. I’ll bring the hammer and screwdriver set.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Gus — I’ve got the usual spot by the community center and an afternoon start. Could you confirm the exact time when you can?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Afternoon works for me — let’s say 2 PM at the usual spot by the community center. I’ll bring the hammer and screwdriver set.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a partial list so far: Eli’s starting with the community center, and I’m still checking the rest. I’ll let you know as soon as I confirm who else is in.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Okay—do you want me to bring tape, gloves, or spare screws?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes—if you can, please bring tape and gloves. I’ll keep checking on the spare screws and the rest of the helper list.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good, Dane — I’ll keep repeating the repair drive plan and let folks know you can swing by late if we’re still short on tape, gloves, or spare screws.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’ll swing by late and bring whatever I’ve got on hand.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Dane — I’ll keep repeating the repair drive plan and let folks know you’ll swing by late with whatever you’ve got on hand if we’re short.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes—the community center is our first stop. I’m still checking the start time and the next pickup so I can keep the route straight.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks—just let me know the start time and next pickup when you’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m on it—I’ll confirm the start time and next pickup as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Great, thanks Sam — head over to the community center and help with the repair work there. I’m pretty sure that’s still the plan.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Noah — I’ll head to the community center and help with the repair work there.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yep, that’s the one — thanks for jumping in, Sam. Just head to the community center and help with the repair work there.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s begin at the community center, then I’ll lay out the rest step by step.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Eli — I will.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good. Meet me at the community center, and I’ll go over the next steps one by one.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: 10 a.m. at Quinn’s place — got it. I’ll keep spreading the word and may swing by if I can.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Noah — I’ve got 10 a.m. at Quinn’s place. I’ll pass that along and let you know if I hear any changes.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out for any updates and share 10 a.m. at Quinn’s place.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, let’s keep it simple: start at the community center Saturday at 10. I’ll wait for the missing-supplies list and we’ll go from there.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, I’ve got the community center for Saturday at 10. Send me the missing-supplies list when you have it, and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Tess—once Cleo sends the list, I’ll keep it clear and we’ll move ahead from there.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Saturday at 10 a.m. at the community center should still work. I can help with any last prep if you need it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Mara. I can start by checking the supply list and seeing who still needs a reminder.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That sounds great, Rey. I’m happy to help with reminders or anything else on the supply list.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely — I’ll help spread the word and point folks to the drop-off time. Keep me posted on the latest parts list, and I’ll work around school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Faye — I’ll send over the latest parts list and any extra hands we still need. Really appreciate you spreading the word at pickup.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Of course — send it when you can, and I’ll share it at pickup.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — where should I start with the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Start with the community center, and I’ll keep track of the next stop after that.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Got it — I’ll start at the community center and keep an eye out for what we need.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do we still need anything besides the hammer and screwdriver set?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m still checking what’s left for the repair drive, and I can bring the hammer and screwdriver set if we still need them.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do you know if we still need tape, gloves, or extra screws?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — I can bring the hammer and screwdriver set, if that still helps. What else do you need covered for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That still helps, thanks. I just need the repair drive’s exact time and the community center location so I can plan the rest.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’ll check the exact time and send you the community center address as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sunday at the community center is the main detail for now. I’ll wait for the next stop when you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sunday at the community center works for me. Thank you, Nell.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great — I’ll keep it to Sunday at the community center and wait for the next stop when you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Just say the usual spot by the community center, and tell them it starts in the afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I’ll tell them the usual spot by the community center and that it starts in the afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect — that’s all I needed.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: It’s now Sunday at the community center, and I’m still gathering what we need. What do you still need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll keep my ears open while I’m out and pass along anything useful I hear about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Ira — that’d be really helpful. If you hear anything, just pass it along and I’ll keep the updated plan moving.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m still checking what’s left for the repair drive, but I can bring the hammer and screwdriver set if we need them.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm the next stop and pickup time? I want to make sure the route stays clear for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’ve got the community center as the first stop, but I’m still checking the exact pickup time. I’ll pass it along as soon as I have the full route.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep — it’s Saturday at 10 a.m. at the community center. I’ll keep an eye out for any extra details and pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, thanks — I’ll check our supplies and make a quick missing list for the repair drive. Tape, gloves, and spare screws would be especially helpful.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — I’ll keep that list in mind and see if anyone can bring tape, gloves, or spare screws. I’ll pass along any other repair drive details as soon as I hear them.
